component.name: Rinne
component.summary: Weekly anime planner that follows each series

description.p: Rinne turns your MyAnimeList list into a 7-day watch plan. When a show ends, its next season takes its place automatically — even if it isn't on your list yet — and Rinne explains why.

ul.li: A weekly schedule built from the shows you're watching
Follows every series: sequels replace finished seasons
Show profiles with cast, voice actors and announced seasons
Themes, a full-HD background slideshow and Discord Rich Presence
